stories.title: Turkse regering doet invallen en arrestaties bij lhbti+-gemeenschap

en.title: Turkish government conducts raids and arrests in LGBTQ+ community
en.summary: Turkish authorities arrested nearly 50 activists and are pursuing legal procedures against 162 individuals and 22 organizations. The operation represents an escalation in the repression of LGBTQ+ people in Turkey.

stories.title: Een hete en droge zomer vol records, maar het kabinet van premier Jetten (ooit klimaatminister) houdt zich stil. Vier verklaringen waarom

en.title: A hot and dry summer full of records, but Prime Minister Jetten's cabinet (once climate minister) remains silent. Four explanations why
en.summary: Despite record-breaking heat and drought conditions, the Dutch cabinet led by former climate advocate Rob Jetten has refrained from public commentary, largely for political reasons.

stories.title: Bijna geen last gehad van muggenbulten of gezoem? Minder muggen in droge en hete zomer

en.title: Barely troubled by mosquito bites or buzzing? Fewer mosquitoes during dry and hot summer
en.summary: The Netherlands experienced relatively low mosquito nuisance this summer, according to data from a tracking project at Wageningen University that monitors reports submitted by the public.

stories.title: Muggen hadden last van zeer droge en hete zomer: 'Zesde generatie vliegt rond'

en.title: Mosquitoes suffered from very dry and hot summer: 'Sixth generation flying around'
en.summary: Researchers from Wageningen University attribute fewer mosquitoes during the summer to extreme drought and high temperatures that disrupted the insects' breeding cycles.

stories.title: Geen aanwijzingen voor opzet of aanslag bij treinontsporing in Frankrijk

en.title: No evidence of sabotage or attack in train derailment in France
en.summary: Authorities found no indication of deliberate action in a train derailment that occurred Friday in northern France. The incident left 44 people injured.

stories.title: 140 mensen vermist doordat Indonesische veerboot in de problemen raakt

en.title: 140 people missing after Indonesian ferry vessel runs into trouble
en.summary: An Indonesian passenger ship carrying 243 people encountered difficulties in the Java Sea due to bad weather on Sunday. Rescue services evacuated 103 people, though one passenger died.

stories.title: 'Geen aanwijzingen voor aanslag' bij ontsporing Franse trein

en.title: 'No evidence of attack' in French train derailment
en.summary: Authorities in France found no indication of sabotage in a regional train derailment near Rouen that injured 44 people on Friday. The train derailed after a piece of rail ended up on the tracks.

stories.title: Elena Rybakina verslaat titelverdedigster Aryna Sabalenka en wint voor het eerst US Open

en.title: Elena Rybakina defeats defending champion Aryna Sabalenka and wins US Open for first time
en.summary: Elena Rybakina won the US Open tennis championship by defeating defending champion Aryna Sabalenka in the final.

stories.title: Nieuwe nummer een van de wereld Elena Rybakina wint US Open

en.title: New world number one Elena Rybakina wins US Open
en.summary: Elena Rybakina won the US Open after also winning the Australian Open earlier in the year, defeating Aryna Sabalenka in the final.

stories.title: Rybakina wint als nieuwe nummer één ook in US Open-finale van Sabalenka

en.title: Rybakina wins US Open final against Sabalenka as new world number one
en.summary: Elena Rybakina defeated Aryna Sabalenka in the US Open final on Saturday. Rybakina had already secured the top world ranking before the match and successfully defended her position by winning the title.

stories.title: Nog geen aanwijzing voor opzet bij ontspoorde trein in noorden van Frankrijk

en.title: No indication of intentional derailment of train in northern France
en.summary: Investigators have found no evidence suggesting the train derailment in northern France was deliberately caused.

stories.title: Man overleden bij aanhouding door politie in Rotterdam

en.title: Man dies during police arrest in Rotterdam
en.summary: A man died while being arrested by police in Rotterdam.
